purpose: Application-level evaluation for RAG chatbot quality covering Correctness, Completeness, and Tone/Style using G-Eval rubrics.
notes: This dataset evaluates application-level user experience (UX) and business requirements.
Targeted for G-Eval (GEval) custom metrics in evals/geval_app_eval.py.

questions.question: What are the working hours for full-time employees, lunch break policy, and how remote work fits into this schedule?
questions.expected_output: Full-time employees work at least 35 hours per week during standard business hours from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM local time, with a one-hour unpaid lunch break. Remote work is permitted up to 3 days per week with manager approval, provided employees remain reachable during core hours of 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
sub_questions: Full-time working hours requirement (35+ hrs/week, 9 AM - 6 PM)
One-hour unpaid lunch break policy
Remote work policy (up to 3 days/week, core hours 10 AM - 4 PM)

questions.question: What is the policy for Paid Time Off (PTO) accrual for a new hire versus an employee with 5 years of service, and how many PTO days can be carried over?
questions.expected_output: A new hire (0–2 years of service) accrues 15 PTO days per year (1.25 days/month), while an employee with 5 years of service accrues 20 PTO days per year (1.67 days/month). Unused PTO may be carried over up to a maximum of 5 days into the following calendar year.
sub_questions: PTO accrual for 0-2 years service (15 days/yr)
PTO accrual for 5 years service (20 days/yr)
Maximum PTO carryover limit (5 days)

questions.question: I received a $150 gift from a vendor. Is this allowed under company policy, and what steps should I take if there's a conflict of interest?
questions.expected_output: Accepting a $150 gift from a vendor is not allowed because Company policy prohibits accepting gifts or hospitality valued above $100 USD. If an actual or potential conflict of interest arises, you must disclose it in writing to your manager and the People & Culture Department.
sub_questions: Evaluation of $150 gift against $100 threshold
Required disclosure process (written notice to manager & HR)

questions.question: How much paid leave is provided for parental leave versus bereavement leave for an immediate family member?
questions.expected_output: Eligible employees receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave following the birth, adoption, or foster placement of a child. For bereavement leave due to the death of an immediate family member, employees receive up to 5 paid days.
sub_questions: Paid parental leave duration (16 weeks)
Paid bereavement leave for immediate family (up to 5 days)

questions.question: What health insurance coverage does Nexora offer, what percentage of premiums is covered, and is there a wellness stipend?
questions.expected_output: Nexora offers medical, dental, and vision insurance, covering 80% of employee premiums and 60% of dependent premiums. Additionally, Nexora provides an annual wellness stipend of $500 for gym memberships, fitness equipment, or wellness apps.
sub_questions: Types of insurance offered (medical, dental, vision)
Premium coverage percentages (80% employee, 60% dependent)
Annual wellness stipend amount ($500) and allowed uses

questions.question: What are the password security rules, and what is required for accessing company systems under the BYOD policy?
questions.expected_output: Passwords must be at least 12 characters long with a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols, and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is required for all systems. Under the BYOD policy, personal devices must be enrolled in the Company's mobile device management (MDM) platform with passcode protection and remote wipe capability.
sub_questions: Password length and complexity rules (12+ chars, mixed types, MFA)
BYOD enrollment requirement (MDM platform, passcode, remote wipe)

questions.question: What happens if an employee's performance falls below expectations, what is a PIP, and what are the steps of progressive discipline?
questions.expected_output: Employees whose performance falls below expectations may be placed on a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) with measurable goals over 30–90 days. Nexora follows a 4-step progressive discipline process: 1) Verbal warning and coaching, 2) Written warning, 3) Final written warning/suspension, and 4) Termination of employment.
sub_questions: PIP definition and timeline (30-90 days, measurable goals)
4 steps of progressive discipline

questions.question: What are the business travel meal allowances for domestic and international travel, and how should airfare be booked?
questions.expected_output: Daily meal allowances (per diem) are $75 USD for domestic travel and $100 USD for international travel in lieu of receipts. All business travel must be pre-approved and booked through the Company travel portal, with economy class for flights under 6 hours and premium economy for longer flights.
sub_questions: Per diem meal allowances ($75 domestic, $100 international)
Airfare booking rules (economy < 6 hrs, premium economy > 6 hrs)

questions.question: How long is the introductory period for new employees, and how is performance evaluated during this timeframe?
questions.expected_output: New full-time and part-time employees serve a 90-calendar-day introductory period beginning on their start date. During this period, performance and fit are evaluated by the employee's manager.
sub_questions: Introductory period length (90 calendar days starting from start date)
Performance evaluation responsibility (evaluated by employee's manager)

questions.question: What are the rules regarding outside employment, second jobs, and freelancing under the Conflict of Interest policy?
questions.expected_output: Employees may not engage in outside employment, freelancing, or business activities that compete with Nexora, interfere with job performance, or utilize Company resources, time, or intellectual property.
sub_questions: Prohibition on competing outside employment or freelancing
Prohibition on using company resources or intellectual property

questions.question: What is the policy on anti-harassment and non-discrimination at Nexora, and how can an employee report an incident?
questions.expected_output: Nexora strictly prohibits discrimination and harassment based on protected characteristics. Employees can report incidents to their manager, Human Resources, or via the confidential employee hotline without fear of retaliation.
sub_questions: Strict prohibition of harassment and discrimination
Reporting channels (Manager, HR, or confidential hotline) and non-retaliation guarantee

questions.question: How many sick leave days do full-time employees receive annually, and is sick leave separate from PTO?
questions.expected_output: Full-time employees receive 10 paid sick leave days per calendar year. Sick leave is provided separately from the Paid Time Off (PTO) bank.
sub_questions: Sick leave allocation (10 paid days/year)
Separation of sick leave from PTO

questions.question: What are the 401(k) retirement plan terms, company matching percentage, and vesting schedule at Nexora?
questions.expected_output: Nexora offers a 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% Company match. Company matching contributions become fully (100%) vested after 2 years of service.
sub_questions: Company match percentage (4%)
Vesting timeline (100% fully vested after 2 years)

questions.question: What is the dress code policy for regular office days versus client meetings?
questions.expected_output: The dress code for regular office days is Business Casual (neat jeans, collared shirts, blouses). For client meetings, formal business attire is required.
sub_questions: Regular office dress code (Business Casual)
Client meeting dress code (Formal business attire)

questions.question: What are the rules regarding workplace safety, reporting injuries, and emergency evacuation drills?
questions.expected_output: Employees must immediately report all workplace injuries or safety hazards to their manager and HR. Nexora conducts mandatory emergency evacuation drills bi-annually, and all employees must follow designated evacuation routes.
sub_questions: Reporting obligation for safety hazards and injuries
Frequency of mandatory evacuation drills (bi-annually)

questions.question: How are expense reimbursements processed, what receipts are required, and what is the submission deadline?
questions.expected_output: Expense reimbursements require itemized receipts for all expenses over $25 USD. Expense reports must be submitted through the finance portal within 30 days of incurring the expense.
sub_questions: Receipt requirement threshold (itemized receipts for $25+)
Submission deadline (within 30 days via finance portal)
